thesis: Austin's A/B conditions make no demand for intention to perform an act, and sincerity-grade states fall under Γ (abuse). Intention-based denials therefore import a non-Austinian condition and owe an argument that apology, promise and similar act types are intention-constituted rather than procedure-constituted. For proxy-occupied roles the question is one of status; for an LLM acting in its own name it may reduce to standing that tracks mind-involving capacities.
